A.name: A
A.query:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(timestamp, 1000000000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts,
       if(JSONExtractString(body, 'host_id') != '', JSONExtractString(body, 'host_id'), attributes_string['loom.record.host_id']) AS host,
       max(toUInt8(JSONExtractFloat(body, 'worktree_root_free_gb') < 30
                   OR (JSONExtractFloat(body, 'worktree_root_total_gb') > 0
                       AND JSONExtractFloat(body, 'worktree_root_free_gb') / JSONExtractFloat(body, 'worktree_root_total_gb') < 0.1))) AS value
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE resources_string['service.name'] = 'loom-ui-d1-export'
  AND JSONExtractString(body, 'kind') = 'host.health'
  AND JSONHas(body, 'worktree_root_free_gb')
  AND timestamp >= {{.start_timestamp_nano}}
  AND timestamp < {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
GROUP BY ts, host
ORDER BY ts

annotations.description: Host {{$labels.host}} reports worktree_root_free_gb below 30 GB or below 10% of worktree_root_total_gb in every host.health record for 10 min (loom-ui-d1-export). A host with no worktree_root_free_gb is unknown, not low. Free space: `loom-daemon clean`/`loom-clean --force`, see troubleshooting.md 'Worker disk full'. Issue #10973.
